title: Roofing trade and buying a clarinet to take lessons
summary: Working as a roofer with his father, he is urged to get a clarinet, buys one and starts fingering lessons, playing in about six months.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: Yeah. And I worked at that so to rent it to you I used to meet him every evening. He said why don't you get you a clarinet? He said you know music already. He said in about six months time you could be making some money. He said I can fix you up in about six months time. Well sure enough I went to work. I bought a clarinet from Whirline. Went up to his house with him and started taking lessons on the fingering. He showed me all the fingering and stuff. All the freak fingering and everything. So in about six months time I was playing.
